configure_panoptic_fpn_model: configure a PanopticFPN model by setting the model target to PanopticFPN from detectron2.modeling
configure_sem_seg_head: configure a SemSegFPNHead with input shapes for feature pyramid levels p2 through p5
set_shape_spec: set a ShapeSpec with stride and channel values for each feature pyramid level
configure_coco_stuff_classes: configure the semantic segmentation head with 54 classes for COCO stuff categories plus background
set_loss_weight: set the semantic segmentation loss weight to 0.5 with group normalization and conv dimensions of 128
